d:
A mechanical Pokémon resembling a vintage clockwork doll with a polished metallic gold body and a floral-patterned skirt. The head is crowned with a small, ornate gold flower and possesses two small, round, glowing blue eyes. The body consists of a rounded torso and slender metallic limbs with three-fingered hands. It has no tail and no wings.
BODY COLOR: polished gold
